cosmosbeta-action-cancel:
The label for the action cancel buttons.

cosmosbeta-adminlinks-edit-js: Text for 'Edit JS file' in Special:AdminLinks, when the AdminLinks extension is installed.

cosmosbeta-adminlinks-edit-tagline: Text for 'Edit tagline' in Special:AdminLinks, when the AdminLinks extension is installed.

The text that shows instead of a username in the top banner if the user is not logged in.

cosmosbeta-counter-label: The label for the article counter in wiki navigation. Uses Plural:$1.
cosmosbeta-createpage-header: The header for the create page pop-up dialog.
cosmosbeta-createpage-input-label: The new page's name input label.

cosmosbeta-createpage-wanted-pages: The second part of cosmosbeta-createpage-text if the wanted pages feature is enabled.
cosmosbeta-editcount-label: The label for the edit count displayed on social profile user pages.
cosmosbeta-explore:
The header for the explore tab in the navigation.

{{Identical|Explore}}
cosmosbeta-personaltools-anontalk: The link text for an anonymous user's talk page in personal tools.
cosmosbeta-personaltools-userpage:
The link text for user page in personal tools.

{{Identical|User page}}
cosmosbeta-personaltools-usertalk: The link text for a logged in user's talk page in personal tools.

cosmosbeta-pref-colormode-dark:
Option of the color mode preference.
{{Identical|Dark}}
cosmosbeta-pref-colormode-default: Option of the color mode preference that follows the wiki default.
cosmosbeta-pref-colormode-light:
Option of the color mode preference.
{{Identical|Light}}
cosmosbeta-rail-page-tools: Heading of the rail module that holds the page tools, when the page tools are set to be shown in the rail.

cosmosbeta-searchsuggest-containing: Label used in the special item of the search suggestions list which gives the user an option to perform a full text search for the term. Used in the Codex typeahead search component.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-advanced: Summary of the collapsed section with the raw theme data.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-advanced-help: Help text above the raw JSON text area.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-comment: Placeholder of the optional edit summary field.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-error-json: Error shown when the submitted theme data is not valid JSON.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-error-permissio: Error shown when someone without permission tries to publish.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-error-revision: Error shown when the revision to restore does not exist.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-error-token: Error shown when the edit token did not match.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-footer-hidden-h: Help text under the list of footer links that can be hidden.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-footer-icons-lo: Tooltip of the footer icons checkbox when the wiki configuration does not allow hiding the icons.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-layout-banner-i: Label of a slider on Special:CosmosBetaThemeDesigner that sets how see through the icons in the top bar are.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-layout-header-i: Label of a slider on Special:CosmosBetaThemeDesigner that sets how see through the icons of the wiki header buttons are.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-protected: Tooltip of a footer link checkbox that cannot be changed because the wiki configuration protects the link.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-readonly: Warning shown to people who can open Special:ThemeDesigner but cannot change the theme.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-restore-comment:
Edit summary used when an older theme is restored. Parameters:
* $1 - revision number
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-success: Message shown after the theme was published.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-text: Intro text shown at the top of Special:ThemeDesigner.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-toolbar-hidden-: Help text under the list of page tools that can be hidden.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-toolbar-style-h: Help text under the page tools style option on Special:CosmosBetaThemeDesigner.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-toolbar-style-r: Option for the page tools style on Special:CosmosBetaThemeDesigner. The tools are shown as a module in the rail.
cosmosbeta-user-blocked:
The text used to show a user is blocked on social profile Pages' avatar area.

{{Identical|Blocked}}
